digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a rebar checkout cannot resolve internal cross-references in packaged author guides (they use consumer-relative paths like review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md).
The required commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help prints it.
Packaged author guides must repoint all dangling references to use hosted URLs or rebar explain <topic> commands instead of repo-relative paths.
A link-resolution guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide contains consumer-relative markdown link targets or bare repo paths.
The commit-trailer topic must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES, discoverable via rebar explain commit-trailer and MCP explain_guide tool, with docstring and tests updated accordingly.
